name: Lolita Syndrome
original_name: ロリータ・シンドローム
source: Pretty girls live in the Maison Rolita. In order to make friends with the girls, you'll go play with them. They're waiting for you in rooms 1 through 5. Now, go into their rooms and play!
translation: 美少女们住在萝莉塔公寓。为了和她们成为朋友，你会去陪她们玩。她们正在1号至5号房等你。现在，进她们的房间和她们玩吧！
